title: The existing integral compactification comparison data in an acyclic module
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell. Use the actual complete integral constructible categories, the semilinear reduction/total-limit adjunction, normalized system realizations, and strict constant-word constructions of the cited dependencies. For a compactification c=(j,p), define directIdentification as the proper/limit comparison followed by limit of the actual open reduction mate, inverse open reconstruction unit and the published compact-support realization [def-sf-integral-compact-support-realization-map]. Define wordCoordinates by inverse compact-support realization, constant scalar direct-image comparison and completed-open sigma, and wordComparison by following it with a_W=L(q_W) eta [def-sf-integral-compactification-word-comparisons]. Define the concatenated word comparison using the append isomorphisms and the recursive a. For a compactification triangle, constantComparison is that comparison followed by L of constantBeta and inverse wordComparison for the composite. Define completedComparison as the unique integral arrow with precisely that image under H. Existence and uniqueness follow from the complete-coefficient Hom bijection. Define semilinearComparison as inverse d_g, then L B_g R(inverse d_f), then L B_g(e), then L(beta), then d_h. Define singleDomain and bridgeDomain to impose the published compatible origins and common finite cohomological and Tor windows on every stated intermediate system. All of these definitions and their existing auxiliary unique-lift and invertibility proofs are retained verbatim; this node records their supporting module, without asserting equality of the two comparisons.

source.place: Step 5; agent-formulated comparison obligation implementing the indicated portion of the integral compactification bridge proof, with Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941 and more-etale.tex Tags 0F7B--0F7D.

proof.text: Auxiliary completedComparison_existsUnique: both compact-support outputs are objects of sfIntegralConstructibleCategory. Apply the canonical constant-coordinate Hom bijection to the already defined constantComparison. Its surjectivity gives the lift and injectivity gives uniqueness. The chosen completedComparison remains determined by its fixed image.

Auxiliary comparisons_isIso: extract the finite-Tor input and open-output conditions from the three singleDomain clauses. Open reconstruction effectivity makes the actual reduction mate and open reconstruction unit invertible. Thus directIdentification is a composite of the proper/limit isomorphism, a functorial image of those invertible maps, and the published integral compact-support realization isomorphism. For wordCoordinates, the transported open output is complete by integralConstantCompleteTransport. Transport invertibility of the constant completion unit along integralOpenScalarIso, then compose with the other two isomorphisms. The normalized word reconstruction theorem makes a for the single and appended words invertible on H(K). Compose with wordCoordinates and the append isomorphisms to obtain the remaining two assertions.

Auxiliary coefficientPrimeUnit: the published PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit gives that the coefficient prime is a unit in the algebraically closed field of the finite-field datum; the declaration only re-exports it.

proof_origin.place: Step 5; comparison of the independently specified normalizations, not a theorem asserted verbatim in Stacks.
